The '''Platform 6 cantina''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located on [[Platform 6]] in the [[Old World]] of [[Zakuul]].<ref name="KotFE 7" /> It was owned by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Bowdaar]] in the aftermath of the [[Eternal Empire conquest]].<ref name="TOR:FF">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=general|Freedom Fight|Zakuul}}</ref> The cantina was directly connected to the [[Arena Grand]], the main gladiatorial arena on Zakuul.<ref name="TOR:TEC">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=general|The Eternal Championship|Zakuul}}</ref>

In [[3631 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|4.0}}</ref> during the [[War against Zakuul]], [[Senya Tirall]] arranged a meeting with [[Reg]] in the cantina, but was ambushed by [[Aitan Brewgs]] and the [[Heralds of Zildrog]] instead.<ref name="KotFE 7" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Platform 6 cantina appears as an area on Zakuul in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion.<ref name="KotFE 7" />
